# California Water Service Begins Palos Verdes Estates Water Main Replacement to Improve Water Supply Reliability, Fire Protection


September 18, 2026 4:00 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://www.calwatergroup.com/_assets/_50fe26f0901332da3cd31fbe4668a909/calwatergroup/news/2026-09-18_California_Water_Service_Begins_Palos_Verdes_818.pdf)


TORRANCE, Calif.—California Water Service (Cal Water) has begun work on a water infrastructure improvement project that will help enhance water system reliability and fire protection for customers in Palos Verdes Estates. Cal Water crews are installing 3,780 feet of new 8-inch water main along Via Pavion.


"This important infrastructure investment will help us continue to provide a reliable supply of high-quality water to our customers," said Ralph Felix, Cal Water's Rancho Dominguez District Manager, whose district serves Carson, Hermosa Beach, Redondo Beach, the Palos Verdes Peninsula, and portions of Compton, Harbor City, Long Beach, Lomita, and Torrance. "Replacing aging water mains is a key part of maintaining a safe and dependable water system and confirming we can continue meeting our customers' needs for years to come."


Construction is expected to be completed by the end of November. Work will take place Monday through Friday, from 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., and crews will work to minimize any disruption to traffic. Traffic control measures will be in place to help keep motorists, pedestrians, and construction crews safe. While some temporary lane closures may be necessary, access for local residents and emergency vehicles will be maintained.


Temporary asphalt will be applied until permanent paving is completed, which can be up to 30 days after project completion.


**About California Water Service**


California Water Service provides high-quality, reliable water utility services to about 450,000 people through 94,000 service connections in our Rancho Dominguez District, and more than 2 million people statewide through 500,000 service connections. Cal Water's purpose is to enhance the quality of life for customers and communities. To do so, it invests responsibly in water and wastewater infrastructure, sustainability initiatives, and community well-being. The company's 1,200 employees live by a set of strong core values and share a commitment to protecting the planet, caring for people, and operating with the utmost integrity. The utility, commemorating a century of service this year, has been named one of "America's Most Responsible Companies" and one of the "World's Most Trustworthy Companies" by *Newsweek* , a USA Top Workplace, and a Great Place to Work®. More information is available at[www.calwater.com](https://www.calwater.com/) .
